Question Paper  
Exam Date & Time: 23-Nov-2025 (09:30 AM - 12:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MANIPAL INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY - BENGALURU  
  FIRST SEMESTER B.TECH. DEGREE EXAMINATIONS - NOVEMBER 2025  
  Engineering Chemistry [CHM-1071]  
Marks: 50                                                                                                            Duration: 180 mins.  
  
  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.  
  
1)                i) Explain the construction and discharging reactions of lithium ion batteries. Write any two                 (4)  
  advantages of it.  
  A)           ii) Discuss the influence of the pH and current density on electro deposition.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)           i) What is the pH of the solution when the cell Pt | H2 | H+(x) | | KCl (0.5 M) | Hg2 Cl2 | Hg is set up at   (4)  
  298 K, which provides an EMF of 1.11 V? (EMF of normal calomel electrode is 0.2810 V). (2  
  Marks)  
  ii) Describe the construction and working of alkaline fuel cell (2 Marks)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)           Write any two differences between:                                                                            (2)  
  i. Galvanic cell and fuel cell  
  ii. Electroplating and electroless plating  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
2)                The concentration of yeast t-RNA in an aqueous solution is 10 M. The absorbance is found to be                (4)  
  0.209 when this solution is placed in a 1.00 cm cuvette and 258 nm radiations are passed through  
  A)           it. (2 Marks)  
  a) Calculate the specific absorptivity  
  b) What will be the absorbance if the solution is 5 M?  
  
  ii) With relevant graphical representation explain the conductometric titration of weak acid vs strong  
  base. (2 Marks)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO2" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)           Define reverse osmosis. Describe with a neat diagram how sea water is purified using this                     (4)  
  technique. Write any two advantages of it.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  C)           i) Define electrodialysis.                                                                                    (2)  
  ii) Distinguish between hard water and soft water  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO4" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  
  Page #1

3)        i) How galvanic series is different from electrochemical series? (1 Marks)                                (4)  
  ii) Explain the electrochemical theory of corrosion. (3 Marks)  
  A)  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)   i) How do the following factors affect the rate of corrosion? (2 Marks)                                   (4)  
  
  pH of the medium.  
  Relative cathodic and anodic area.  
  
  ii) Discuss the importance of selection of proper material and good design for corrosion control. 2(  
  Marks)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  C)   Identify and explain the following forms of corrosion:                                                    (2)  
  i) Copper piping connected to steel tanks.  
  ii) Deposition of extraneous matter on the surface of iron.  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
4)        i) Differentiate between the following (Any two points each) - (2 Marks)                                  (4)  
  a) Thermotropic and lyotropic liquid crystal.  
  A)   b) Matrix and dispersed phase.  
  ii) Explain the chemical vapour deposition process of thin film fabrication with suitable example. (2  
  Marks)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  B)   i. Polyethylene sample has the following composition (3 Marks)                                            (4)  
  Degree of polymerization                                   400        300        200        100  
  % of composition                                           10         20         30         40  
  Calculate the number average molecular weight, weight average molecular weight and PDI of the  
  given polymer sample  
  
  ii. Why polyvinyl chloride (PVC) has higher strength than Polyethylene? (1 Mark)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  C)   Explain the sol-gel method for the preparation of nanomaterials.                                          (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
5)        i) Define decomposition potential of an electrolyte. (1 Mark)                                             (4)  
  $$ii) At 80°C, temperature co-efficient = -1.75 \times  10-4 V/K and Ecell = 2.89 V for the cell Pt I H2 (g) II$$  
  A)   HCl (aq) I Cl2 I Pt. Calculate the free energy, enthalpy and entropy for the cell reaction - H2(g) +  
  Cl2(g) = 2HCl(aq) (3 Marks)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO1" / Cognitive Level: "Application"  
  
  B)   i) Explain the preparation of nanomaterials by ball milling method. (2 Marks)                             (4)  
  ii) Explain the working of liquid crystal displays in calculators.(2 Marks)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO5" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  C)   Explain the role of addition of Hydrazine (N2 H 4 ) and ZnSO4 in corrosion inhibition                     (2)  
  
  Course Outcome: "CO3" / Cognitive Level: "Understand"  
  
  
  Page #2
